commitResults.messageTitle: Add Level-0: rename Duke to Chin, greet and exit
commitResults.messageBody:
Renames the starter Duke.java to Chin.java, drops the ASCII banner,
and prints the required greeting + farewell so the app exits after
one pass. Also fills in the [to be filled] student profile fields in
AGENTS.md and updates the Java-version note to match the local JDK 21
Corretto setup instead of the template's Java 25 default.

Add A-Streams: replace imperative loops with Stream pipelines
commitResults.messageBody:
Refactor three read-side hot spots to use the Stream API. The goal is
smaller, more declarative code and a chance to practice the increment
required by A-Streams and A-FullCommitMessage in the same pass.

Motivation:
  * The find-in-list, load-from-disk, and print-numbered-list loops all
    followed the "collect-into-a-fresh-list" pattern. Streams express
    that intent in one line and remove the manual accumulator variable
    that peer reviewers previously flagged as noisy.
  * Streams also make the null-filter in Storage.load explicit
    (Objects::nonNull) instead of the earlier if-null-continue trick.

Changes:
  * TaskList.find: filter tasks by lowercased-substring match and
    collect the result. Removes the local ArrayList and for-each loop.
  * Storage.load: Files.readAllLines() -> stream().map(deserialize)
    -> filter(nonNull) -> collect(toCollection(ArrayList::new)). Falls
    back to an empty list on IOException so the caller stays uniform.
  * Storage.save: tasks.stream().map(Task::serialize).forEach(pw::
    println). Same behaviour, terser expression.
  * Chin.executeCommand LIST/FIND: IntStream.range(0, size).forEach
    replaces the classic indexed for-loop so the "1-based numbered
    output" pattern is written once.

No behavioural change is intended. Existing JUnit tests still pass and
the JavaFX GUI is unaffected because both go through the same
public API.
